whatsappMessage:
Hi Sunny's Shakes & Cakes,

I noticed your bakery has strong 4.4★ reviews in Sri Krishna Nagar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for cake orders and home delivery inquiries.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake ordering, menu showcase, aur instant location navigation integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sunnyshakes

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Sunny's Shakes & Cakes team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your West Boring Canal Road location showcase. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
